DocuForge AI v1.2.21

Developed by Anil Sharma · Former General Manager, Central Bank of India

Create • Convert • Translate • Extract • Protect — all your documents, one toolkit. Everything runs in your browser; your files are never uploaded anywhere.

📄

PDF Tools

Merge, split, rotate, crop, reorder, watermark, page numbers, headers/footers, forms, compress.

🖼

OCR & Image Tools

Create searchable PDFs using OCR, with a real embedded text layer (where supported — accuracy depends on scan quality and language); extract text from photos, pull tables from images, build PDFs from images.

🌍

Translation

Translate text or whole PDFs across 38 languages, side by side, exportable in four formats.

🔄

Document Conversion

Convert PDF content into editable Word, Excel, PowerPoint, CSV, HTML, JSON, and images — and back again. Structure and text carry over; exact original formatting may not.

🤖

AI Assistant

Summarize, rewrite, simplify, chat with a PDF, extract action items and dates — using your own API key.

📊

Spreadsheet Tools

Turn a spreadsheet or CSV straight into a chart, no other software needed.

🔐

Security

Visual signature stamps, form fill & flatten. Password-protected PDFs aren't currently supported — see below for why.

📂

Batch Processing

Run one operation across many files at once and download everything as a single .zip.

Most PDF tools activate once you open a PDF in the editor — that's why some buttons start out greyed out.

Privacy, plainly: most document processing runs entirely in your browser — nothing is uploaded. AI and Translation send only the text you choose to process, never your original file, to the provider you pick or supply your own key for.

"Translate text/document/PDF" extracts text locally and uses Google translation first for better grammar and context, with MyMemory as fallback. "Translate via AI" uses a proper language model instead — noticeably better with grammar and context, but needs an API key. Google's Gemini API has a genuinely free tier if cost is a concern.

Convert

Arrange

All PowerPoint tools here are structural, not visual: they work from each slide's extracted title and bullet text, not the original OOXML package. Backgrounds, images, custom layouts, and fonts aren't preserved — the same honest limit as the PDF ⇄ PowerPoint conversion above.

Quick tasks

More & document

Uses AI (your own API key) to write a complete, single-file website from a description — same as the AI tools, just given its own home since it's a substantial feature on its own.

Calculates interest month by month, from the 1st through the last day of each calendar month inclusive, on the daily closing balance carried forward from your statement's transactions — the standard convention for savings-account interest.

Password protection uses a community fork of the core PDF library, not the well-established one the rest of this app relies on — test that your protected file actually opens with the password before trusting it for anything sensitive. Not recommended for confidential or legally sensitive documents until more thoroughly validated. Cryptographic digital signatures still aren't supported; that genuinely requires a certificate authority.
